description: Build a pixel-mapping chain from a source TOP to an LED fixture grid and DMX Out CHOP over Art-Net or sACN. The generated network resizes to width×height, samples one texel per fixture pixel, preserves RGB channels, and returns created node paths, channel count, warnings, and live Brightness/Universe controls on the parent COMP. It defaults to a moving Ramp test source so the chain can cook without input; real network output still requires a reachable fixture/node and should be verified before sending. Use create_dmx_fixture_pipeline for fixture patching and this tool when you specifically need image-to-pixel mapping.

fps.description: Output frame rate (DMX Out CHOP sample rate).

height.description: Rows of pixels. 1 = a single LED strip.

layout.description: Pixel wiring order along the strip/grid: horizontal (rows left-to-right), vertical (columns), or serpentine (alternate rows reversed — boustrophedon strips).

name.description: Base name for the created nodes.

net.description: Network DMX protocol: Art-Net or sACN (streaming ACN).

net_address.description: Target IP address for Art-Net / sACN. Defaults to the operator's own default.

parent_path.description: COMP to build the pixel-map chain in.

source.description: TOP path whose image is mapped to the fixtures. If omitted, a built-in moving Ramp TOP test source is created so the chain cooks with no input.

start_channel.description: DMX start channel (1-512) of the first pixel within the starting universe.

start_universe.description: Art-Net / sACN universe of the first pixel.

width.description: Pixels per row (columns). Each texel of the WxH grid drives one LED fixture.

name: create_led_mapper
title: Create LED pixel-mapper
